title: CIA-paid paramilitary bases for Cuban exiles
place_text: No Name Key, Swan Island, Everglades, Lake Pontchartrain

tellings.quote: And they set up these these bases. They set one up on Noame Key. They set one up on Swan Island.

plain: Between 1960 and 1962, says a researcher named Dan Sheehan, the CIA paid for armed training camps for Cuban exiles in places such as No Name Key, Swan Island, the Florida Everglades and Lake Pontchartrain. Sheehan sums it up for Michels without naming a source: "They set one up on No Name Key. They set one up on Swan Island."
